visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Dictionary Order Is Reversed
visualizerParams.problemDescription: cat comes after car in dictionary order, but the program says it comes before.

solution.explanation: A positive result must mean the first string is bigger (comes later). Subtracting in the wrong order flips the sign, so every comparison gives the opposite answer.

tests.pattern: (?<![\s\S])\s*cat vs car: after[ \t]*\r?\ncar vs cab: after\s*(?![\s\S])
